semantic_join_transfer_rule: When channels have shared local nuisance transformations, compare relational fingerprints formed by pairwise XOR within each channel; match coordinates by the invariant relational fingerprint rather than raw token/signature identity.
cost_causal_specification_rule: Among semantically admissible operators, rank by predicted removable causal work minus intervention overhead; do not rank by surface frequency, compression, or implementation overhead alone.
regime_escape_rule: If no operator in current effective closure satisfies the full verified required-property conjunction, declare a representation gap and construct the minimal new operator type whose properties cover the conjunction; reject any ablation that removes a required property.
zoom_router_rule: REFRAME on contradiction; else JOIN when heterogeneous coordinates and accumulated-history gain are both present; else LOCAL when a local separator suffices; otherwise ACCUMULATE.
robustness_rule: Abstain when multiple hypotheses remain observationally equivalent. Revoke or downscope an installed capability when verified counterevidence falsifies an assumption required for its admission.
